from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, summarize_run
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import sdh_fft, sdh_onset

def run(i):
    return open_run(Path.cwd() / 'data' / str(i))

g6 = run(6)
print(summarize_run(g6))
B6 = g6.col('magnet_field')
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(9, 6), sharex=True)
ax[0].plot(B6, g6.col('sr0_X'), lw=0.7)
ax[0].set_ylabel('raw sr0 X (V)')
ax[1].plot(B6, g6.col('sr1_X') * 1e6, lw=0.7)
ax[1].set_ylabel('raw sr1 X (µV)')
ax[1].set_xlabel('B (T)')
fig.suptitle('data/6 — raw lock-in channels, electron spot')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

R6 = np.abs(g6.col('sr1_X') / (g6.col('sr0_X') / g6.meta['measurement_config']['sr0_gain']))
ix6 = np.argsort(B6); B6s, R6s = B6[ix6], R6[ix6]
f6, spec6 = sdh_fft(R6s[:, None], B6s, b_range=(2, 10), nfft=2048, bg_degree=5, log=False)
p6, _ = find_peaks(spec6[0]); p6 = sorted((j for j in p6 if 4 < f6[j] < 40), key=lambda j: -spec6[0, j])[:6]
print('data/6: Rxx median/max %.1f/%.1f Ω; |I_gate|max TG/BG %.3f/%.3f nA' %
      (np.median(R6), np.max(R6), 1e9*np.max(np.abs(g6.col('k_2400_tg_curr'))), 1e9*np.max(np.abs(g6.col('k_2400_bg_curr')))))
print('FFT peaks, 2–10 T: ', [(round(float(f6[j]), 2), round(float(spec6[0, j]), 1)) for j in p6])
try: print(sdh_onset(R6s, B6s, b_lo=1.0, b_hi=10.0, r_full_scale=5000).summary())
except ValueError as err: print('onset unavailable:', err)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(9, 6))
ax[0].plot(B6s, R6s, lw=0.7); ax[0].set(xlabel='B (T)', ylabel='|Rxx| (Ω)', title='data/6 — measured-current resistance')
ax[1].plot(f6, spec6[0]); ax[1].set(xlim=(0, 45), xlabel='SdH frequency (T)', ylabel='FFT magnitude (a.u.)', title='2–10 T; B-polynomial background removed')
for j in p6[:4]: ax[1].axvline(f6[j], ls=':', lw=0.8)
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

Run 6 take: the electron spot has coherent oscillations over the measured range (Rxx median 54 Ω, max 530 Ω; TG/BG current maxima 0.123/0.117 nA). The 2–10 T spectrum contains peaks around 15, 22.5 and 30 T; a low-frequency ~7 T component persists to the 1 T analysis edge but sits near the background residual. Harmonics and the parallel CNP ridge can imitate multiple pockets, so this trace establishes fan feasibility rather than stacking. The 10 T traverse took 120.4 min (921 points), calibrating the field and point-time price for Plan step 4.

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, summarize_run
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import sdh_fft, sdh_onset

def run(i):
    return open_run(Path.cwd() / 'data' / str(i))

g7 = run(7)
print(summarize_run(g7))
B7 = g7.col('magnet_field')
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(9, 6), sharex=True)
ax[0].plot(B7, g7.col('sr0_X'), lw=0.7)
ax[0].set_ylabel('raw sr0 X (V)')
ax[1].plot(B7, g7.col('sr1_X') * 1e6, lw=0.7)

ax[1].set_xlabel('B (T)')
fig.suptitle('data/7 — raw lock-in channels, hole spot')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

R7 = np.abs(g7.col('sr1_X') / (g7.col('sr0_X') / g7.meta['measurement_config']['sr0_gain']))
ix7 = np.argsort(B7); B7s, R7s = B7[ix7], R7[ix7]
f7, spec7 = sdh_fft(R7s[:, None], B7s, b_range=(2, 10), nfft=2048, bg_degree=5, log=False)
p7, _ = find_peaks(spec7[0]); p7 = sorted((j for j in p7 if 4 < f7[j] < 40), key=lambda j: -spec7[0, j])[:6]
print('data/7: Rxx median/max %.1f/%.1f Ω; |I_gate|max TG/BG %.3f/%.3f nA' %
      (np.median(R7), np.max(R7), 1e9*np.max(np.abs(g7.col('k_2400_tg_curr'))), 1e9*np.max(np.abs(g7.col('k_2400_bg_curr')))))
print('FFT peaks, 2–10 T: ', [(round(float(f7[j]), 2), round(float(spec7[0, j]), 1)) for j in p7])
try: print(sdh_onset(R7s, B7s, b_lo=1.0, b_hi=10.0, r_full_scale=5000).summary())
except ValueError as err: print('onset unavailable:', err)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(9, 6))
ax[0].plot(B7s, R7s, lw=0.7); ax[0].set(xlabel='B (T)', ylabel='|Rxx| (Ω)', title='data/7 — measured-current resistance')
ax[1].plot(f7, spec7[0]); ax[1].set(xlim=(0, 45), xlabel='SdH frequency (T)', ylabel='FFT magnitude (a.u.)', title='2–10 T; B-polynomial background removed')

Run 7 take: the hole spot also oscillates strongly (Rxx median 197 Ω, max 587 Ω; TG/BG current maxima 0.216/0.120 nA). Its 2–10 T spectrum includes ~12.5 T and ~22.5 T components; a ~5–7 T feature overlaps the low-frequency background uncertainty. The 10→0.3 T ride-down took 95.7 min for 486 points. Neither spot trace alone identifies a stacking sequence, but the signal quality and low leakage support the density-resolved fan in Plan step 4.

## HERA — Plan step 4: D = 0 electron Landau fan (`landau-fan`)

> **05:24** · Landau fan: B 0→10 T, D=0, n\_A +0.4…+3.2×10¹² cm⁻²; 116×57; TG +0.181…+0.984 V, BG +0.128…+1.166 V, Si 0 V; sr1 200 µV, τ 0.1 s · **ETA ~09:24** (≈4h)

Runs 6–7 establish unclipped, low-leakage SdH signal; run 6 has peaks near 15, 22.5, and 30 T, with a possible ~7 T low-frequency component. Run 5 calibrates the ridge-A D = 0 line and shows a parallel region-B CNP displaced by 0.43 × 10¹² cm⁻². This fan measures the hardwired B_1–B_2 pair over **n_A = +0.4…+3.2 × 10¹² cm⁻²** at D = 0: 57 co-swept TG/BG points per field row, B = 0→10 T with 0.1 T steps to 1.5 T, 0.05 T to 3 T, then 0.1 T to 10 T (116 rows). The high-n endpoint is 16 mV below the TG limit; Si stays at 0. At fixed 10 nA drive, sr1 sensitivity 200 µV gives 20 kΩ full scale; both active lock-ins use τ = 0.1 s, 24 dB/oct and a 1 s fast dwell (10τ). The run records current, Rxx voltage, temperature, both gate currents, and both gate readbacks. The low-n edge excludes A's CNP and the hole side, avoiding the largest high-field Rxx; those require a later targeted pass if the electron fan is ambiguous.

**Preflight:** the cell checks live logfile age, T_sample 1.0–1.5 K, B within 0.05 T of zero, TG/BG/Si at 0, heater ranges off, PS heater and magnet output on, committed validators, gate pacing, drive, and lock-in slope before any write. The 10 T field traverse costs at least 73 min at 0.137 T/min. Run 5 took 81.2 min for 4,158 gate-map points at 1 s dwell; scaling to 6,612 points gives ~129 min, plus the field traverse, per-row settle/flyback and the observed ~5–10% overrun: **about 4 h**. Interrupting a magnet ramp does not stop the supply, so any early stop is at a completed row/point followed by a measured-field readback; the supply must be handled by the operator if its ramp itself is unsafe.

**Checkpoints:** inspect the first 2–3 landed rows for gate leakage, lock-in railing, readback errors, and a live oscillatory channel; then review roughly every 20 rows and at 3, 6, and 9 T for emerging ridges and density-offset families. The cell requests interruption at ≥1 nA gate current or ≥90% sr1 full scale. If early rows wash out or clip, stop and re-plan before paying for the rest of the field traverse. After completion, compare Landau ridge sequences and intercepts against ABAB, ABCA, and ABCB expectations, allowing a second family displaced by region B's measured offset. Only B_1–B_2 is wired, so the verdict is for that pair.

# Plan step 4 — D=0 electron Landau fan, hardwired B_1–B_2 pair.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# Preconditions: all state inherited from the operator's state0 replay, not set by this cell.
assert_thermometry_live('T_sample', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_sample'], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T, _Tv, _B = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
_vt, _vb, _vs = k_tg.volt(), k_bg.volt(), k_si()
print(f'preflight: T_sample={_T:.3f} K (1.0..1.5), T_vaporizer={_Tv:.3f} K, '
      f'B={_B:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05), TG/BG/Si=({_vt:+.4f},{_vb:+.4f},{_vs:+.4f}) V (zero)')
print(f'preflight: PS={magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output={magnet.output_enabled()}, '
      f'heater ranges={heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0), '
      f'gate nplci={k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), step={k_tg.volt.step}/{k_bg.volt.step} V')
print(f'preflight: drive={sr1.amplitude()} V, sr0/sr1 tau={sr0.time_constant()}/{sr1.time_constant()} s, '
      f'slopes={sr0.filter_slope()}/{sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct')
assert 1.0 <= _T <= 1.5 and 0.7 <= _Tv <= 1.5
assert abs(_B) < 0.05 and max(abs(_vt), abs(_vb), abs(_vs)) < 0.01
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert abs(k_tg.volt.step - 0.005) < 1e-9 and abs(k_bg.volt.step - 0.005) < 1e-9
assert abs(sr1.amplitude() - 1.0) < 0.01 and sr0.filter_slope() == 24 and sr1.filter_slope() == 24
assert (TG_MIN, TG_MAX, BG_MIN, BG_MAX, SI_MIN, SI_MAX, B_SESSION_CAP) == (-0.3, 1.0, -1.3, 2.0, -25.0, 25.0, 10.0)
assert (k_tg.volt.vals._min_value, k_tg.volt.vals._max_value) == (TG_MIN, TG_MAX)
assert (k_bg.volt.vals._min_value, k_bg.volt.vals._max_value) == (BG_MIN, BG_MAX)
assert (k_si.vals._min_value, k_si.vals._max_value) == (SI_MIN, SI_MAX)
assert (magnet.field.vals._min_value, magnet.field.vals._max_value) == (-B_SESSION_CAP, B_SESSION_CAP)

# Run-5 ridge-A calibration: ratio is data-calibrated, absolute c_tg remains a geometry prior.
CAL = dict(c_tg=0.0027960593093052633, c_bg=0.002160696465377614,
           n_offset=-0.08937933224099137, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.4, 3.20001, 0.05), 5)
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), **CAL)
B_vec = np.round(np.r_[np.arange(0, 1.50001, 0.1),
                       np.arange(1.55, 3.00001, 0.05),
                       np.arange(3.1, 10.00001, 0.1)], 4)
assert len(n_vec) == 57 and len(B_vec) == 116 and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
assert np.all((TG_MIN <= Vtg_vec) & (Vtg_vec <= TG_MAX))
assert np.all((BG_MIN <= Vbg_vec) & (Vbg_vec <= BG_MAX))
assert B_vec.min() >= 0 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
_nr, _dr = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, **CAL)
assert np.max(np.abs(_nr - n_vec)) < 1e-9 and np.max(np.abs(_dr)) < 1e-9
print(f'fan: {len(B_vec)} B rows x {len(n_vec)} n points = {len(B_vec)*len(n_vec)} points; '
      f'B {B_vec[0]:.2f}..{B_vec[-1]:.2f} T; '
      f'TG {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V; BG {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V')

# Signal is large in runs 6–7, so τ=0.1 s permits a 1 s/point (10τ) dwell.
sr0.time_constant(0.1); sr1.time_constant(0.1)
sr1.sensitivity(200e-6)
print(f'lock-ins: tau={sr0.time_constant()}/{sr1.time_constant()} s, sr1 sensitivity={sr1.sensitivity()} V '
      f'(20 kΩ FS at 10 nA)')
assert sr0.time_constant() == 0.1 and sr1.time_constant() == 0.1 and sr1.sensitivity() == 200e-6

mc = dict(meas_config)
mc['Si (V)'] = _vs; mc['sample_temperature:'] = _T
mc['comments'] = ('landau-fan: D=0 electron line, run-5 ridge-A calibration; n_A +0.4..+3.2e12 '
                  'in 0.05e12 steps, B 0..10 T (0.1/0.05/0.1 T segments), 1 s fast dwell, sr1 200 uV, tau 0.1 s')
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D=0, n_A={n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 (57 pts); '
              f'TG {Vtg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vtg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V, BG {Vbg_vec[0]:+.4f}..{Vbg_vec[-1]:+.4f} V; '
              f'B 0..10 T (116 rows; 0.1/0.05/0.1 T segments); run-5 cal c_bg/c_tg={CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, '
              f'n0={CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D0={CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm; sr1=200 uV, tau=0.1 s')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(Vbg_vec[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(Vtg_vec[0]))
interruptible_sleep(3)

# row = [time, B, Vtg_set, Vbg_set, T_sample, I_tg, I_bg, Vtg_read, Vbg_read, sr0_X, sr0_P, sr1_X, sr1_P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr).fp(k_tg.volt).fp(k_bg.volt)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', T_sample); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
s.plot('time', k_tg.volt); s.plot('time', k_bg.volt)
s.plot('time', sr0.P); s.plot('time', sr1.P)

def fan_guard(station, data):
    itg, ibg, x = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6])), abs(float(data[11]))
    if itg >= 1e-9 or ibg >= 1e-9 or x >= 0.9 * 200e-6:
        print(f'FAN TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, n_A~{float(data[2]):.4f} V TG: '
              f'|I_tg|={itg:.3e} A, |I_bg|={ibg:.3e} A, |sr1_X|={x:.3e} V')
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

fan_result = s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                              slow_delay=0, fast_delay=1.0)
print(f'fan ended: B={magnet.field():+.4f} T, TG={k_tg.volt():+.4f} V, BG={k_bg.volt():+.4f} V; '
      f'interrupted={fan_result.metadata.get("interrupted")}')

from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm

assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V; "
      f"roundtrip n,D = {calc_nD(Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: sweep starts at 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

# --- field grid: uniform in B (blocking rate-limited magnet). 50 mT to 1 T (background only), 10 mT 1 -> 10 T:
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack((np.arange(0.0, 1.0, 0.05), np.arange(1.0, 10.0001, 0.01))), 4))
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 50 uV = 5 kOhm full scale at 10 nA (R(B=0) ~ 70 Ohm = 1.4 % FS; MR + SdH maxima at high B size the headroom).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check electron: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0 -> 10 T, 10 mT above 1 T, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'electron side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0 -> 10 T uniform-B (50 mT to 1 T, 10 mT above); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field stays at 10 T (the hole-side spot check rides it down) — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
